current_evidence: No published local validation list could be found on canterbury.gov.uk (process pages, site-restricted searches), and MHCLG's planning.data.gov.uk record for Canterbury's local area requirements (entity 20308) notes "Couldn't find any sort of checklist".

issues.detail: The workbook's 'Validation list URL' is the generic 'The planning application process' overview page. It is not a local validation list: it only links to sub-pages (find out if you need permission, pre-app advice, create/submit an application, what happens next).
issues.evidence: Page is titled 'The planning application process'; it does not mention a local validation list, local list or validation checklist.

issues.detail: Status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' is wrong. The page loads normally. The real problem is that Canterbury does not appear to publish a local validation list at all, so the row should say 'no local list published' rather than suggest a list exists behind a blocked link. The URL came from a third-party directory (planninggeek.co.uk) and was never checked.
issues.evidence: planning.data.gov.uk/entity/20308 (canterbury-local-area-requirements): Notes "Couldn't find any sort of checklist"; Quality "Some: We have some data from an alternative source".

issues.detail: The nearest thing to local requirements on the council site is a short table on the 'Create a planning application' page, which Grokbot did not record: site plan at 1:1250 or 1:2500 for all applications; block plan at 1:500 for extensions, boundary walls and fences, outbuildings and garages; floor plan for extensions, outbuildings and garages; elevations at 1:100 for extensions, new or replacement windows and doors, boundary walls and fences, outbuildings and garages. A separate council page covers Stodmarsh water quality (nutrient neutrality) for planning applications. Neither is labelled as a validation list.
issues.evidence: canterbury.gov.uk/planning-and-building/planning-application-process/create-planning-application, table 'What you need for a planning application'; related link 'Planning applications and Stodmarsh water quality'.

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' field is just the council homepage (https://www.canterbury.gov.uk), not a planning or validation page.

summary: Grokbot's link works but goes to a generic planning-process page, not a validation list, and its 'blocked/404' status is wrong. No current local validation list could be found for Canterbury (MHCLG's own data notes "Couldn't find any sort of checklist"), so there was nothing to check contents against.
